title: Anchoring What Matters: A Dual-Level Learning Framework for Visually-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.18057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has significantly improved the reasoning capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs). However, standard on-policy RLVR algorithms face a critical optimization bottleneck in preserving and reinforcing visually grounded reasoning behaviors: valuable visually-grounded reasoning trajectories are discarded after a single update, while uniform token advantage allocation prevents the model from reinforcing critical perception or reasoning steps. To bridge this gap, we propose PIVOT, a dual-level learning framework that anchors policy optimization around informative visual reasoning signals. Specifically, PIVOT introduces a self-calibrated experience replay mechanism, which selectively collects and replays visually-grounded historical experiences as stable reference anchors for policy optimization. translated_title: 锚定关键要素：一种面向视觉接地多模态推理的双层学习框架
translated_abstract: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已显著提升了大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的推理能力。然而，标准的同策略RLVR算法在保持和强化视觉接地推理行为方面面临关键的优化瓶颈：有价值的视觉接地推理轨迹在单次更新后即被丢弃，同时均匀的token优势分配阻碍了模型对关键感知或推理步骤的强化。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了PIVOT，一个以信息丰富的视觉推理信号为锚点的双层学习框架。具体而言，PIVOT引入了一种自校准的经验回放机制，选择性地收集并回放视觉接地的历史经验，作为策略优化的稳定参考锚点。在此基础上，我们进一步设计了一种视觉引导的优势分配机制……
tldr: 提出PIVOT双层学习框架，通过自校准经验回放机制和视觉引导优势分配机制，将策略优化锚定于视觉接地推理信号，从而提升大型视觉语言模型的多模态推理能力。
en_tdlr: PIVOT, a dual-level learning framework that anchors policy optimization around informative visual reasoning signals through self-calibrated experience replay and vision-guided advantage allocation, thereby enhancing visually-grounded multimodal reasoning in large vision-language models.
